_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 72 windows showing ±2+ point score movement, this is a textbook coil — HOLD is the statistically honest call and wins when the score holds, while a directional UP claim requires naming the breaker (fed_liquidity at 0 is the identified catalyst but has not yet triggered).
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst calls direction UP with low conviction toward Hope, narrative implies an imminent re-rating, but neither brain has identified a breaker that has actually fired; the coil regime penalizes forced directional guesses (0-for-18 historical record).
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity rises above 15 with btc_momentum_30d clearing 55 and funding staying below 60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 75 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d dropping below 70 and funding turning negative
